Every link response uses supplied_evidence with computed=false. Missing receiver G/T or gain plus noise temperature, atmospheric_loss_db, data_rate_bps and required_ebn0_db prevent independent margin computation. No retry or zero-loss placeholder was used.

The atmospheric_model text label alone does not supply numerical atmospheric loss; the tool still requires atmospheric_loss_db and did not produce a model-derived attenuation. No availability claim is independently established.

The four accepted debris calls echo caller-declared compliant=true with computed=false. No estimated_lifetime_years, meets_25_year_rule or evidence_contradiction field was returned. Missing area-to-mass and passivation data prevent independent decay and passivation verification.

Disposal perigee/apogee default to operational altitude: 520/520, 515/515, 525/525 and 510/510 km for SAT-1 through SAT-4. No drag-sail dynamics or perigee-lowering manoeuvre was demonstrated; SAT-3 remains at 525 km in the screening response. SAT-5 was blocked, so these output fields are null.
All satellites have failing line-2 TLE checksums; SAT-3 alone has a passing line-1 checksum. Nine of ten lines fail. Accepted orbit calls are not evidence of verified TLE integrity.
